name: Access Net Australia
summary: Business dialup/permanent-connection ISP (Access Net Internet Services Pty Ltd); wound down ~2013-15.

names.name: Access Net Australia
source: 1998 homepage: 'Based in Melbourne, and formed in 1994 Access Net Australia … provides internet services': https://web.archive.org/web/19980201053239id_/http://www.access.net.au/

events.details: Business dialup, cohosting, national local-call dialup. 1998 homepage states 'Based in Melbourne, and formed in 1994'.
Retail ISP wound down; no acquisition found. Exact wind-down date is uncertain — the access.net.au domain persisted with Wayback captures continuing into the 2020s.
source: Wayback CDX for access.net.au (captures continue past 2013-15): http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=access.net.au
